Exact crop of the published Players Committee Virtual Cards Master List (Dark Side), PDF page 23: the slip of [[Bantha Herd (V) (Errata 3)]] (official text as of 27 April 2013; PDF built February 2014). It prints errata version PC-E3 (“Deploy on a Tatooine site. Once per turn, may place up to 3 cards from hand face down here. If a battle was just initiated against your lone Tusken Raider, may 'react' by deploying (for free) any Tusken Raider(s) and/or Bantha(s) here. [Immune to Alter]”), word for word the text of [[Bantha Herd (V)]].<ref>[[Media:Virtual_Legacy_Final_Master_DS.pdf|Master List (Dark Side)]]. Original: http://www.starwarsccg.org/Resources/MasterDS.pdf. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20170704232650/http://www.starwarsccg.org/Resources/MasterDS.pdf Internet Archive].</ref>

Source SHA-256: <code>c63bf528513446184251b17042bb3992227dc4906436348ed7fe1c38b9df3840</code>. Crop rectangle in PDF points: <code>[25, 318, 209, 406]</code>, rendered at 200 dpi (11 November 2026, batch R8-B4).
